profile.summary: AIDO.RNA is a family of RNA foundation models from GenBio AI; its Hugging Face repositories and current code use the name GB.RNA. The models read an RNA sequence one nucleotide at a time and turn it into embeddings that a downstream model can use, for tasks such as RNA secondary structure prediction, mRNA-related prediction and RNA function prediction. The largest model has 1.6 billion parameters and was trained on 42 million non-coding RNA sequences.
profile.summary_source_locator: 1.6B model card: opening paragraph; Hugging Face API id

summary_quotes.text: GB.RNA-1.6B is a general-purpose RNA foundation model with 1.6 billion parameters, trained on 42 million non-coding RNA sequences at single-nucleotide resolution.
including RNA secondary structure prediction, mRNA-related tasks, RNA function prediction, and RNA inverse folding

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: The models are encoder-only transformers pretrained with a masked language modelling (MLM) objective: parts of the sequence are hidden and the model learns to predict them. The 1.6B model has 32 layers, hidden size 2,048, feed-forward size 5,440 and 32 attention heads, with a vocabulary of 16 tokens. The 650M model's configuration has 33 layers, hidden size 1,280, intermediate size 3,392 and 20 attention heads. Both configurations use rotary position embeddings and SwiGLU activations. Users normally adapt a backbone to a task through GenBio's ModelGenerator framework, which offers embedding, sequence-level and token-level classification, and regression heads.

quotes.text: GB.RNA is an encoder-only transformer and is pre-trained using masked language modeling (MLM) objective.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: The repository documentation lists seven RNA backbones: gb_rna_1b600m, gb_rna_1b600m_cds, gb_rna_650m, gb_rna_650m_cds, gb_rna_300m_mars, gb_rna_25m_mars and gb_rna_1m_mars. GB.RNA-1.6B and GB.RNA-650M were trained on non-coding RNA. GB.RNA-1.6B-CDS and GB.RNA-650M-CDS are domain-adapted versions for coding sequences, whose Hugging Face metadata name the base models. The three MARS models were trained on 886 million RNA sequences from the MARS database. The Hugging Face repositories read are named GB.RNA rather than AIDO.RNA, and the sources read do not explain the difference. The model cards call the backbones aido_rna_1b600m and aido_rna_650m, while the pinned repository uses gb_rna_ names. A result should name the checkpoint, its Hugging Face revision and the backbone name used; this page read GB.RNA-1.6B at revision cea90e53 and GB.RNA-650M at revision efaf4af4.

facts.label: Architecture
facts.value: Encoder-only transformer. 1.6B: 32 layers, hidden size 2,048, feed-forward size 5,440, 32 attention heads. 650M: 33 layers, hidden size 1,280, intermediate size 3,392, 20 attention heads. Rotary position embeddings and SwiGLU activations in both configurations.

facts.label: Outputs
facts.value: Embeddings from the backbone, or logits from a classification or regression head added through ModelGenerator (sequence-level or token-level).

facts.label: Parameters
facts.value: 648,372,368 (GB.RNA-650M, safetensors count); 1.6 billion (GB.RNA-1.6B, model card). The MARS cards give 1 million (1M-MARS) and 300 million (300M-MARS); the 25M-MARS card also says 300 million, which does not match its name, and the sources do not explain this. No counts were found for the CDS versions.

facts.label: Training data
facts.value: 42 million unique ncRNA sequences from RNAcentral version 24.0 for the 1.6B model (model card); the 650M card says 42 million non-coding RNA sequences and does not name the database release; 886 million RNA sequences from the MARS database for the MARS models. The CDS versions were domain-adapted for coding sequences; their adaptation data are not described in the sources read.

facts.label: Known versions
facts.value: Seven backbones in the repository documentation: gb_rna_1b600m (GB.RNA-1.6B), gb_rna_650m (GB.RNA-650M), gb_rna_1b600m_cds and gb_rna_650m_cds (coding-sequence versions), and gb_rna_300m_mars, gb_rna_25m_mars and gb_rna_1m_mars. The model cards use aido_rna_ backbone names. Task-specific fine-tuned GB.RNA-1.6B checkpoints are also on Hugging Face but are not covered here.

facts.label: Training cutoff
facts.value: Not reported as a date. The 1.6B model card identifies its training data as RNAcentral version 24.0, but the sources read give no date for the data or the training run, and the paper was not read.

facts.label: Context limits
facts.value: 1,024 tokens, the max_position_embeddings value in the config.json of both the 1.6B and 650M models. The models use rotary position embeddings, and the sources read do not say whether longer inputs are supported. The repository's example backbone configuration, for gb_rna_1b600m_cds, sets max_length: 1024.

facts.label: Weights licence
facts.value: GenBio AI Community License, a non-commercial licence. The Hugging Face metadata of every checkpoint read gives the licence as "other", and the cards link to the GenBio AI Community License. Its grant covers non-commercial purposes only and forbids using outputs to train similar models, with stated exceptions.

run_guide.summary: Install ModelGenerator from the repository at a pinned commit and compute embeddings for two short RNA sequences with the GB.RNA-1.6B backbone.
prerequisites: Python 3.10, 3.11 or 3.12, as the README badge states.
Git and pip. GPU type and memory for inference are not stated; the repository's fine-tuning experiments were run on NVIDIA A100-80G GPUs.
Code and weights are under the GenBio AI Community License: non-commercial use only. The Hugging Face repositories are not gated.

steps.title: Get and install the code
steps.shell:
git clone https://github.com/genbio-ai/ModelGenerator.git
cd ModelGenerator
git checkout --detach bda6f2da297ba886e3662b49eea9928feacbfd98
pip install -e .
steps.explanation: The README's source install, with a checkout line added to pin the commit this page was written from.

steps.title: Compute embeddings
steps.shell:
python - <<'PY'
from modelgenerator.tasks import Embed
model = Embed.from_config({"model.backbone": "gb_rna_1b600m"}).eval()
transformed_batch = model.transform({"sequences": ["ACGT", "AGCT"]})
embedding = model(transformed_batch)
print(embedding.shape)
print(embedding)
PY
steps.explanation: The model card's embedding example, wrapped in a shell heredoc. The card names the backbone aido_rna_1b600m; the backbone list at the pinned commit names it gb_rna_1b600m, so that name is used here. For the 650M model use gb_rna_650m.

outputs: The shape of the embedding tensor and the tensor itself, printed to the terminal, as in the model card example.
limitations: These commands were read from the repository and model card and have not been executed by Rewire.
The backbone name in the second step is taken from the repository documentation, not from the model card, because the two differ.
The repository is described by its authors as deprecated.

notes: This page is meant for both AIDO.RNA records (lit-microbial-20261011-virobench-model-aido-rna and lit-rna-20261011-rnalm-zeroshot-model-aido-rna). The saved API response artifacts/hf-api-aido-1.6b.json gives the GB.RNA-1.6B identifier; no saved file says when or why the name changed, so the page states both names without explaining it. The paper is on bioRxiv: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.11.28.625345v1.full.pdf (not fetched, per run rules). OpenReview (NeurIPS 2024 workshop) returned a challenge page and was not used. The 1.6B parameter count is the card's rounded figure; the API response gives no safetensors count for it. The 25M-MARS parameter field is null because its card says 300 million. The repository LICENSE and the cards are under the GenBio AI Community License, so store_bytes is false for them. The released field is null: the API createdAt values are repository creation dates and were not used.
